name: lastfm-music-discovery
description: Read-only Last.fm listening history for music discovery, rediscovery, and familiarity checks.

interface.shortDescription: Use Last.fm history to discover and rediscover music.
interface.longDescription: Read recent scrobbles and listening charts, check whether a listener already knows an artist, and surface historically important artists they have not played recently.
defaultPrompt: Use my Last.fm history to suggest five albums I might enjoy.
Find artists I used to listen to a lot but have neglected recently.
Check whether I already know this artist before recommending them.
